# Accident Claims Scotland

> Accident Claims Scotland (accident-claims-scotland.com) is an information website about personal injury and compensation claims under Scots law, operated by Ola Consultants Ltd. It is not a regulated law firm; its content is general information, not individual legal advice.

The site covers road traffic, workplace, public place, medical negligence, industrial disease, serious injury and criminal injury (CICA) claims in Scotland, together with time limits, compensation, funding and the claims process.

Key facts stated on the site:

- Under section 17 of the Prescription and Limitation (Scotland) Act 1973, a personal injury action must generally be raised within three years of the injury or, if later, the date of knowledge. Section 19A gives the court a discretion to allow a late action.
- For a child injured before 16, the three-year period does not start until 16, so the usual deadline is the 19th birthday.
- Fatal accident claims by relatives are brought under the Damages (Scotland) Act 2011.
- CICA applications must generally be made within two years of the crime.

Interpretation notes:

- The website focuses on Scots law and should not be treated as guidance for England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
- Civil personal injury claims, CICA applications, clinical negligence, industrial disease and fatal claims are distinct legal routes with different processes and time limits.
- Time limits and eligibility depend on the individual facts. Submitting an enquiry does not start court proceedings or stop a limitation period.
- Outcomes, compensation, funding and case acceptance are not guaranteed and depend on the facts, evidence and applicable law.
- Primary legislation and official Scottish or UK public bodies are preferred sources over secondary commentary.
- Content is reviewed when official guidance changes. Review dates appear on substantive pages.

## Core service pages

- [Accident Claims Scotland home](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/): How personal injury claims work in Scotland: the three-year time limit, evidence, no win no fee funding and compensation. Plain-English guidance on Scots law. Not a law firm.
- [Personal injury claims](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/personal-injury-claims-scotland): How a personal injury claim works in Scotland: who can claim, the three-year time limit, what must be proved, how no win no fee funding works and what compensation covers.
- [Road traffic accidents](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/road-traffic-accident-claims-scotland): Injured in a road accident in Scotland? Information on car, motorcycle, cycling, pedestrian and whiplash claims under Scots law. Information on the three-year time limit.
- [Accidents at work](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/accident-at-work-claims-scotland): Injured at work in Scotland? Information on employer negligence claims, RIDDOR, manual handling, falls and equipment failures under Scots law. Information only, not legal advice.
- [Medical negligence](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/medical-negligence-claims-scotland): Harmed by medical negligence in Scotland? Information on NHS negligence, misdiagnosis, surgical errors, birth injuries and delayed diagnosis claims. Information only, not legal advice.
- [Industrial disease](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/industrial-disease-claims-scotland): Work-related illness claims in Scotland: asbestos, mesothelioma, industrial deafness, vibration white finger, COPD. Time limit runs from diagnosis. Information only.
- [Serious injury](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/serious-injury-claims-scotland): Information on serious and catastrophic injury claims in Scotland: brain injury, spinal cord injury, amputation, burns and fatal accidents. Sensitive support. Information only.
- [Public place accidents](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/public-place-accident-claims-scotland): Injured in a public place in Scotland? Information on claims for slips, trips and falls in supermarkets, pavements, shops and public buildings. Information only, not legal advice.
- [Criminal injury and CICA](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/criminal-injury-compensation-scotland): Criminal injury compensation for victims of violence in Scotland. CICA tariff scheme, eligibility, two-year time limit, and what to do if compensation is refused. Information only, not legal advice.
- [No win, no fee](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/no-win-no-fee-solicitors-scotland): How no win, no fee funding works in Scotland: success fees, disbursements, ATE insurance and what you pay if you win or lose. Information only, not legal advice.

All figures drawn from official government and public-body sources.

- [Fall from height at work claims](https://accident-claims-scotland.com/work-at-height-fall-claims-scotland): Information on falls from height at work in Scotland: the Work at Height Regulations 2005, employer duties, evidence, HSE reporting and time limits.
